Engineering Job |area1= [[The Rogue Harbour]] |area2= |quest1= |quest2= }} {{status | name = Combat-Ready | icon = Combat-Ready status icon.png | type = Buff |description = You deal increased Damage, and have increased Attack, Cast and Movement Speed. |bonuses = {{c|help|Combat-Ready Grants 100% increased Damage, 25% increased Attack and Cast Speed, and 15% increased Movement Speed}} }} '''Huck, the Soldier''' is a NPC located in [[the Rogue Harbour]]. He is a [[rogue]] to hire for a variety of jobs in a [[Heist]] and [[Grand Heist]]. To unlock Huck, run a contract with [[Karst, the Lockpick]]. ==Profile== {{See also|Guide:Heist equipment}} Huck grants the following bonuses during [[heist]]s: *{{c|mod|Is a powerful Combatant and provides strong Buffs to Allies}} *{{c|mod|Players have 20% increased Experience gain}} With a Level 5 job, Huck will provide {{c|mod|Players have 30% increased Experience gain}}. Huck will periodically cast a buff that grants the Combat-Ready buff for ~90 seconds, which grants 100% increased Damage, 15% increased Movement Speed, and 25% increased Attack and Cast Speed. The bonus experience effect only applies in (Grand) Heists. ===Jobs=== Huck can do the following jobs: {| class="wikitable" ! Job !! Max level !! Best tool |- | [[File:Lockpicking job icon.png|40px|link=Lockpicking]] [[Lockpicking]] | 3 | {{il|Standard Lockpick}} |- | [[File:Brute force job icon.png|40px|link=Brute force]] [[Brute force]] | 3 | {{il|Studded Bracers}} |- | [[File:Demolition job icon.png|40px|link=Demolition]] [[Demolition]] | 3 | {{il|Trarthan Flashpowder}} |- | [[File:Engineering job icon.png|40px|link=Engineering]] [[Engineering]] | 3 | {{il|Flanged Drill}} |} ===Combat style=== Huck fights enemies with his [[Two-handed sword|sword]]. His [[strike]]s can hit multiple enemies if they are directly in front of him. Every so often, he uses a [[warcry]] that grants nearby [[Ally|allies]] the Combat-Ready [[buff]], which increases their damage, attack speed, cast speed and movement speed for a long duration. His damage in combat receives the most benefit from [[rogue's gear]] that grants increased melee damage, such as {{il|Standard Sharpening Stone}}. ==Personal Dialogue== ===Introduction=== * "Sir! Sorry, old habit. You'll get used to it. Blackguard training did a number on me. I'm Huck. Served in the Oriath 3rd for five years. Dishonourably discharged, though I consider that an honour.

My time with the Blackguards put a lot of things in perspective, least once I had some distance from them. What we do here might be illegal, but that don't make it wrong.

You need something -- anything -- you come to me, yeah? We're family now. Family look out for each other." ===The Boss=== * "Haven't actually met him myself. Been dealing mostly with lady Kurai. Bit like the old days, really. Orders come down the chain and stop when they hit the right pair of ears. I'm eager to meet him though. Owe him my life. Had some very dark days after I got discharged. Not a lot of people want to hire veterans, especially when they leave the service under less-than-ideal circumstances. But the Boss secured me a place to live, and gave me a steady income and work to keep me busy." * "I understand. The Boss is intent on giving you the support you need, but realise that if you harm any members again, you will be asked to leave." [[Huck]] * "Understood. And... Sorry." [[Kurai]] ==Personal Questline== * [[Contract: Enoch's Whereabouts]] ===='''Preparation'''==== * "Ah, my contract. Took it out not long after joining the Ring to track down a mate of mine. Man named Enoch. Not easy making friends at my age, but active duty has a way of forging near-unbreakable bonds. Enoch and I got real close. Might as well've been brothers. Right before I got discharged, Enoch was called up to a special unit we'd heard rumours about. A group under the direction of Piety, of all people. Supposedly some elite strike force, but no one personally knew anyone who was a part of it. 'Til Enoch, that is. After I started working for the Boss, I asked Whakano to find Enoch. Thought he might be a good fit. But Whakano found no traces. I want to break into the Blackguard Records and find out where he's deployed." ===='''During'''==== * "Let's see... Good. Enoch's file is in here. Let's go." ===='''Completion'''==== * "Gods damn them. Piety, Dominus, Gravicius, the whole lot of 'em. They moved Enoch into an 'Unspecified Research' unit. Dead a month later, the cause listed as 'Severe reaction to subdermal augmentations'. They tried to turn him into a gods-damned gemling, and killed him in the process. Oh, Enoch. I'm so sorry, mate. I appreciate the backup, Exile. I need a bit of time to sort my emotions out, but I reckon I'll have more work for you soon enough." * [[Contract: Enoch's Remains]] ===='''Preparation'''==== * "Not long after we found Enoch's file, Whakano informed me that he'd found Enoch's family, and that even they had no idea where he was. They assumed he was still on duty. Can you believe that? The bloody Templars had the gall to massacre Enoch and not even tell his family. That just don't sit right with me. His records don't list a final resting place, but I know that most blackguards who died on duty were cremated and put to rest in the tunnels beneath the city. It's a long-shot, but maybe we can find some trace of Enoch, to give his parents peace." ===='''Completion'''==== * "Enoch was the sort of man who'd starve to make sure you had something to eat. The sort of man whose oath to protect and preserve informed everything he did. He deserved far better than he got, and we can do nothing for him now. But with his service records and his tags, we can at least let his mum and dad know what happened. Don't worry, Exile. I'll handle this messy part. You've done more than enough. Thank you." ==Lore== Huck had a friend called Enoch who was working for the Templar Blackguard. In the first contract [[Contract: Enoch's Whereabouts]], Enoch went missing and Huck tasks the player with finding the records to indicate his current posting. The records reveal that Enoch was killed in duty and the Templars didn't even inform his parents. In [[Contract: Enoch's Remains]], Huck tasks the player with finding Enoch's cremated remains in the tunnels beneath Oriath. The player finds Enoch's scorched remains and retrieves his Tags as a memento for his parents. ==Additional Interactions== ===Niles=== * "Thought we might be able to use another hand on this one. Meet Niles." * "You don't like me, I can tell." * "He used to be an interrogator for the Templar. Can read minds a little bit." * "Now you really don't like me. Why is that, I wonder?" * "Just remember that he's very useful. I find that helps." ==As an ally in maps== {{main|The Dutiful Soldier}} Huck can join the player in [[map]]s by taking [[The Dutiful Soldier]] [[atlas passive]] and opening a [[Smuggler's Cache]] in a map. He periodically uses a 100-second buff that grants damage and increased attack, cast, and movement speed every 45 seconds. Modifiers from Rogue Gear apply to Huck in maps, allowing him to grant [[Aura]]s and other benefits to allies. Modifiers to Heist specific mechanics do not function. Modifiers to "area is not in lockdown" do not apply in maps. ==Voice actor== Huck is voiced by New Zealand voice-over artist [https://www.imdb.com/name/nm12541196/ Blair Annison Chisholm]https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2940528 who also voices [[Tujen]]. ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.20.1| * [[Huck]] now brings along his [[Rogue's equipment|Rogue Equipment]] when accompanying you in Maps. }} {{Version history table row|3.20.0| * [[Huck]] can now accompany you in Maps by allocating [[The Dutiful Soldier]] [[Atlas passive]]. {{Undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|3.13.0| *Job Experience granted to Heist participants [Rogues] has been increased across the board to fit the lower frequency at which players will engage in them. *Huck now grants increased experience to players in Heists, up to 20% at job level 3. }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Heist}} {{Navbox NPCs}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Rogues]]
